name: Ticetown Square
summary: Ticetown Square is a neighborhood shopping center on U.S. Route 9 in Old Bridge, New Jersey, offering convenient retail and services to the local community. The center maintains a 4.3-star rating and serves as a practical shopping destination for everyday needs.
demographics: Ticetown Square serves the Old Bridge, New Jersey community, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding Middlesex County area. The trade area consists primarily of suburban households with moderate to above-average incomes, including young families and established residents seeking convenient shopping along the U.S. Route 9 corridor. Visitors typically engage in routine shopping trips and service-based errands, with a preference for accessible, neighborhood-oriented retail options that cater to everyday needs.
description: Ticetown Square is a neighborhood shopping center located along U.S. Route 9 in Old Bridge, New Jersey, serving the local community with convenient retail and service options. The center benefits from its strategic location on one of New Jersey's major commercial corridors, providing easy access for residents throughout Middlesex County. While the center maintains a modest profile, it offers practical shopping solutions for everyday needs in a straightforward strip center format. The property operates daily from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, accommodating the schedules of working families and local residents. With a solid 4.3-star rating from over 400 Google reviews, Ticetown Square has established itself as a reliable community shopping destination in the Old Bridge area.
